surah.personality_title: Surah Ar-Rahman (The Universal Symphony of Mercy & The Celestial Balance)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Opens identifying the divine Teacher of the Qur'an by His most merciful Name (Ar-Raḥmān), and closes blessing that very Name: Tabāraka ismu rabbika dhi al-jalāli wa al-ikrām (55:78).
surah.overview: Surah Ar-Rahmaan (The Beneficent) is the 55th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 78 ayat. Classified as Madani.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Most Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Taught the Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who taught the Quran

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Created man
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He created man

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And] taught him eloquence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and taught him to communicate

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the stars and trees prostrate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the plants and the trees submit to His designs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That you not transgress within the balance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so that you may not exceed in the balance

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He set down the Earth for His creatures

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And grain having husks and scented plants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: its husked grain, its fragrant plants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجࣲ مِّن نَّارࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِنْ مَارِجٍ مِنْ نَارٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وخلق الجان من مارج من نار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the jinn out of smokeless fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From both of them emerge pearl and coral
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنْشَآتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وله الجوار المنشات في البحر كالاعلام
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Everyone upon the earth will perish
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Everyone on earth perishes

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ويبقى وجه ربك ذو الجلال والاكرام
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَسْأَلُهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يساله من في السماوات والارض ۚ كل يوم هو في شان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We will attend to you, O prominent beings
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ تَنْفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانْفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنْفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا معشر الجن والانس ان استطعتم ان تنفذوا من اقطار السماوات والارض فانفذوا ۚ لا تنفذون الا بسلطان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظࣱ مِّن نَّارࣲ وَنُحَاسࣱ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِنْ نَارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنْتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يرسل عليكما شواظ من نار ونحاس فلا تنتصران
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةࣰ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِذَا انْشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاذا انشقت السماء فكانت وردة كالدهان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَيَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسࣱ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يُسْأَلُ عَنْ ذَنْبِهِ إِنْسٌ وَلَا جَانٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فيومئذ لا يسال عن ذنبه انس ولا جان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالْأَقْدَامِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يعرف المجرمون بسيماهم فيؤخذ بالنواصي والاقدام
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذه جهنم التي يكذب بها المجرمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is Hell, which the criminals deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is the Hell the guilty deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Having [spreading] branches
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With shading branches

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In both of them are two springs, flowing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With a pair of flowing springs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With every kind of fruit in pairs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: متكئين على فرش بطائنها من استبرق ۚ وجنى الجنتين دان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنْسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فيهن قاصرات الطرف لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As if they were rubies and coral
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Like rubies and brilliant pearls

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is the reward for good [anything] but good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Shall the reward of good be anything but good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There are two other gardens below these two

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Dark green [in color]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Both of deepest green

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In both of them are two springs, spouting
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With a pair of gushing springs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In them are good and beautiful women
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There are good-natured, beautiful maidens

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Fair ones reserved in pavilions
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Dark-eyed, sheltered in pavilions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنْسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Untouched before them by man or jinni
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرࣲ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: متكئين على رفرف خضر وعبقري حسان
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَبَارَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تبارك اسم ربك ذي الجلال والاكرام
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour
